text:
emma-marketing: Hey @ali-runtime quick favor for the launch blog: we need a compact, reproducible benchmark to justify the embed+rerank headline.
emma-marketing: Ask in one line: run fp32 vs int8 on the embed+rerank flow, provide p50/p90/p99/p999 and one slide-ready example showing rerank stability. Cohort ~160. Warmup required.

ali-runtime: Got it. Which models and payload mix? Also do you want scoring (ndcg) or only latency/throughput?

emma-marketing: Prefer rwin-open-7b fp32 + rwin-open-7b-int8. Payload split: 70% short (<120 tokens), 30% long (2k-4k). Include ~8 interactive cached hits to demonstrate KV cache. Need NDCG@10 for rerank.

sam-devex: Please tag traces with campaign=launch-blog, channel=web, and sample_tag for the slide examples. Add span annotation warmup=true/false.

devon-eng: Timeline: smoke run tonight on staging; full sweep tomorrow afternoon. We can deliver a smoke artifact + short report by 09:00 local tomorrow if this is high priority.

emma-marketing: High priority for copy freeze. If full sweep misses the deadline, ship the smoke artifact.

bench-bot: Job queued  
 id=51234 queue=staging-bench variants=[rwin-open-7b-fp32,rwin-open-7b-int8] cohort=160 longpct=30 scoring=ndcg@10 ETA smoke=2024-06-25T22:00Z.

ali-runtime: Repro command we'll run:
run_bench --cohort=launch_pack_compact.json --models=rwin-open-7b-fp32,rwin-open-7b-int8 --warmup=30 --samples=160 --concurrency=6 --trace-tags "campaign=launch-blog,channel=web" --scoring ndcg@10 --output artifacts/2198819999-compact-sweep.tar.gz

ali-runtime: We'll include: per-request latencies (p50/p90/p99/p999), token throughput, ndcg@10, 8 tail examples per variant, and a README with git/model shas + instance SKU. We'll scrub PII but keep slide examples readable.

devon-eng: If int8 shows >12% p99 regression vs fp32 we'll snapshot kernel profiles and loop-in infra. We'll also capture kernel timings in the artifact.

emma-marketing: Perfect. Please also pick one rerank example where order is preserved for slide highlight; if order changes, include a short human note on quality delta.

bench-bot: Job 51234 started on staging-node-11 at 2024-06-25T21:58:31Z.

ali-runtime: Will update this thread with smoke results and attach artifacts. :white_check_mark:
